sentences.text: 1 This Writ Petition has been filed seeking for issuance of a Writ of Mandamus directing the first and second respondents to act upon the representation made by the petitioner on 14.12.2020 and to enhance the compensation amount for the lands acquired from the petitioner under National Highways Act.

2.Heard Mr.T.Chandrasekaran, learned Counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner and Mr.A.K.Manikkam, learned Special Government Pleader appearing on behalf of the respondents.
3.In the considered view of this Court, the award was passed on 28.01.2009 and the representation has been made by the petitioner to the first and second respondents nearly after 11 years in the year 2020.
The National Highways Act itself provides for a procedure to seek for enhancement of compensation and time limit has been fixed.

In view of the same, there is no question of directing the respondents to consider the representation after 11 years and hence, the relief sought for by the petitioner cannot be granted by this Court.
4.The Writ Petition is dismissed in the above terms.
